annotationRationale: The derivation models the coin counts and total value with two linear equations, then solves by subtraction. Value equals denomination times count supplies the supporting quantity relationship.
sourceMethod: Followed the official model using the number of 5-cent coins and the requested difference as the two unknowns, with the elimination arithmetic made explicit.

review.mathCheck: The system reduces to \(3n+d=20\) and \(8n+5d=58\). Elimination gives \(n=6\), then \(d=2\), choice C. Counts 6, 9 and 8 are nonnegative integers totaling 23 coins and 320 cents.
review.sourceMethodCheck: Faithful, originally worded adaptation of MAA solution 8 (p. 3), using the requested difference as the second unknown. Explicit elimination and value verification make the official method reconstructible.
review.annotationCheck: Modeling and elimination are correctly assessed; denomination times coin count is supporting knowledge. All three immediate concepts are used.
